true_answer: The set of natural numbers that are outputs is called the range of the function (in this case, the range is { 3 , 4 , 7 , 12 , 19 , 28 ,... } , all the natural numbers that are 3 more than a perfect square). There can only be one answer for any particular function. Example 0.4.1 The following are all examples of functions: 1. f : Z → Z defined by f ( n ) | 3 n .
